title: Word order 2: adverbs with the verb

exercises.instruction: Is the word order OK or not? Correct the sentences where necessary.

items.prompt: I cleaned the house and also cooked the dinner.
I have usually a shower in the morning.
answers: I usually have a shower in the morning.

items.prompt: I’m usually hungry when I get home from work.
I called him and I sent also an email.
answers: I called him and I also sent an email.

items.prompt: You don’t listen! I have always to repeat things.
answers: You don’t listen! I always have to repeat things.

items.prompt: I never have worked in a factory.
answers: I’ve never worked in a factory.
I have never worked in a factory.

items.prompt: I never have enough time. I’m always busy.
When I arrived, my friends already were there.
answers: When I arrived, my friends were already there.
When I arrived, my friends were there already.

exercises.instruction: Rewrite the sentences to include the word in brackets.

answers: Clare doesn’t usually drive to work.

items.prompt: I don’t have to work on Sundays. (usually)
answers: I don’t usually have to work on Sundays.

items.prompt: Do you watch TV in the evenings? (always)
answers: Do you always watch TV in the evenings?

items.prompt: Martin is learning Spanish, and he is learning Japanese. (also)
answers: Martin is learning Spanish and he is also learning Japanese.

items.prompt:
a We were on holiday in Spain. (all)
b We were staying at the same hotel. (all)
c We had a great time. (all)
answers: a We were all on holiday in Spain.
b We were all staying at the same hotel.
c We all had a great time.

items.prompt:
a The new hotel is expensive. (probably)
b It costs a lot to stay there. (probably)
answers: a The new hotel is probably expensive.
b It probably costs a lot to stay there.

items.prompt:
a I can help you. (probably)
b I can’t help you. (probably)
answers: a I can probably help you.
b I probably can’t help you.
